# defence-before-fix.github.io

> Defence Before Fix (DBF): a phase that runs before a defect is fixed: the instance is treated as evidence of a class, and the defence that detects the class is built and seen to fire before the fix is made. Method, detector and toolchain specifications.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Defence-Before-Fix/defence-before-fix.github.io): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://defence-before-fix.github.io/): Official website and documentation.
